subject: Priority sweep — declare true commitments for aging opportunities
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Priority sweep — we need decisive closes/archivals by EOD Friday

Team —

Quick one: Finance flagged a cluster of 'commit' and late-stage opps for Acme (ACME-2026-129) that moved no stages in the last 60 days. We need only two outcomes by EOD Fri 5/15: 1) declare a firm close date and next-step that supports a true commit, or 2) move to "No Decision/Archive".

I pulled the export (attached) and highlighted 6 deals that are inflating our forecast and increasing variance. Ben — you own Acme. Can you work with Liz to confirm whether the POC timelines below are accurate and commit or archive? Monica/Hannah — please triage any cross-sell/opportunity duplicates and confirm SF owner tagging is correct.

Ask: Update Stage and Close Date in Salesforce, add a one-line reason in the {Forecast Notes} field, and reply-all with the decision. If you need a quick call to unstuck, ping me and I can join.

Thanks,
Alex

Attachments: acme-MAP-v3.pdf (PDF), opportunity-listing.csv (CSV)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Priority sweep — we need decisive closes/archivals by EOD Friday

On Tue, 12 May 2026 at 15:02, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Quick one: Finance flagged a cluster of 'commit' and late-stage opps for Acme (ACME-2026-129) that moved no stages in the last 60 days...

Agree — thanks for the nudge. I spoke with Liz this morning. Short summary:
- Primary POC (Liz) still expects a Q3 pilot, but procurement has re-prioritized resources until their budget refresh in late July.
- The technical POC is happening, but timelines are "soft" — no signed SOW.

Plan: I will push for a firm calendar commit by Friday and offer a 2-week pilot start window as a gating event. If procurement doesn't give a clear calendar by 5/15, I will change stage to "No Decision" and archive the current close date.

I'll update SF and cc you. If anyone has a better escalation route into their procurement team, share it.

Ben

From: Liz Connor <liz.connor@acme.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Priority sweep — we need decisive closes/archivals by EOD Friday

Ben —

Thanks for the heads up. Short and candid: procurement is on a heavy cost-reduction push and our budget window has shifted. We're still enthusiastic about Redwood's performance, but I can't commit to dates until the budget meeting on 7/02.

Options that would help us move forward quickly:
- A limited-time pilot credit to prove ROI before procurement sign-off.
- A narrower SOW that scopes only core infra for the POC (reduces procurement review time).

If you want, we can do a 20-minute call on Monday to align on a pilot SOW draft.

Liz
Head of Data Engineering, Acme Corp

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Liz Connor <liz.connor@acme.com>, Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Priority sweep — we need decisive closes/archivals by EOD Friday

Thanks, Ben and Liz — helpful context.

Decision and next steps (for the record):
- Ben will set SF stage to "Commit - Soft" and update Close Date to 2026-07-02 (the budget meeting) with a one-line note: "Procurement reviews budget 7/02 — pilot credit discussed; awaiting decision."
- If no signed SOW or calendar commit by 2026-07-09 we will move the opportunity to "No Decision/Archive" and remove it from the current forecast.
- Monica: please check for any duplicate/opportunistic records under Acme and consolidate owner tags by EOD 5/19.
- Hannah: run a quick pipeline variance calc (linked SF view) and flag if this change moves us >4% from target so I can notify Finance.

I will log the decision in the forecast notes and update the forecast workbook after Ben confirms the SF changes.

Alex Martinez
Director, Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
